questions.answer: Courses available, weather, close to the water (surfing and sports)

questions.answer: none

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: I lived in international housing - this worked pretty well because it was more apartment like and bigger than dorms which gave more privacy and also fun to live with americans and other exchange students.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: We had a kitchen. but you also have to buy a meal plan.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: its was fun and easy due to larger distances and easy to make friends here. but people are not used to live alone like people in Denmark so it was more messy and you had to be the more adult one.
